Naming sun tan lotion "sun tan lotion" is like naming a condom "fertility aid." They're literally designed to stop the effect in the name from happening
Not true. The effect sun tan lotion seeks to avoid is sunBURN. You're welcome.

Um, no. Originally sun tan lotion (also called sun tan oil) was made to enhance the skins ability to tan not prevent sunburn or skin damage. It was a formulation of oils and other ingredients that would bronze the skin when sunbathing. It reduced the more damaging UV rays while permitting some of the less damaging UV rays that would produce more melanin in the skin. Sun block or sun screen is the opposite which is formulated to block the UV rays that would cause tanning and sunburn by being opaque at those wavelengths. The two products are not remotely the same in their intended outcome or use. You don't find much sun tan lotion on the market now because of the fear of skin cancer so nearly everything sold today is actually sunblock.
